title: ZDI advisory: RustDesk Client for Windows reg_recovery local privilege escalation (CVE-2026-131827), fixed by vendor
date_note: ZDI gives 24 November 2026 as the coordinated public release date; the page gives no earlier day.
summary: Zero Day Initiative advisory ZDI-26-1080 describes a missing-authorization flaw in the main IPC endpoint exposed by the RustDesk service in the Windows client. An attacker who can already run low-privileged code could exploit it to execute arbitrary code as SYSTEM. ZDI lists a CVSS score of 7.8 and says RustDesk has issued an update to correct the vulnerability.
plain: A flaw in RustDesk's Windows client lets someone who already runs low-privileged code gain SYSTEM rights. ZDI says RustDesk has issued an update.
exec: A local privilege escalation in a remote-desktop client could give SYSTEM rights; ZDI says a vendor fix exists.
action: ZDI points to RustDesk's update, described in GitHub pull request #17040, as the fix.

validation.note: Only the ZDI advisory was read; VulDB, CVE Feed and Vulners entries were not opened.

review.note: CVE, CVSS 7.8, IPC missing authorization, vendor update, PR 17040, 24 Nov date checked against ZDI advisory
